correctness.rationale: An edge-rooted decomposition of each nontrivial tree gives exactly q(q-1) choices for its root edge, then independent local choices counted by (d-1)![z^(d-1)]cosh(z)(1+sinh(z))^(q-2). The unique-parent property proves bijective exhaustive counting. Isolates and q=2 boundaries are explicit. The separate direct-coloring predicate agreed with the closed product on 4516 tree/palette cases; exact rational EGF agreed with 50 local factors and the q=3 formula held for all 18248 labeled trees of orders 2..7. Finite computation does not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: Exact counting for every forest and all q>=2 is a natural complete invariant not determined by known two-/three-color existence. The degree-multiset factorization is a non-obvious structural invariance and q=3 counts vary exponentially with degrees; the local factors make arbitrary-degree exact calculation immediate. These are meaningful beyond restating a threshold.
